title: Activation function: squared ReLU → GELU
description: Changed MLP activation from F.relu(x).square() to F.gelu(x)
reflection: Hypothesis: GELU is standard in modern LLMs and offers smoother gradients than squared ReLU. Reality: the change regressed val_bpb to 1.014313 vs baseline 0.996221 (−0.018 BPB, 1.8% worse). The unconventional squared ReLU activation is actually better-tuned for this specific model and training regime. Architectural changes are not a solution to the tight local optimum — the baseline design choices appear genuinely optimal.
